notes: `check` runs the same code path as `update` and can write; always pass -g for global scope.
The global lock's skillFolderHash is the upstream git tree SHA of the skill folder; a tree-URL install at a 40-hex ref stays at that ref on update.
DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 (or DO_NOT_TRACK=1) disables both the telemetry event and the add-time audit call.

skills.sh's documented /api/v1 requires a Vercel OIDC token (https://skills.sh/docs/api, read 2026-09-26); discovery uses `skills find <query>` (the CLI's unauthenticated /api/search) and the site pages, and the raw audit risks behind the page labels come from https://add-skill.vercel.sh/audit?source=<owner/repo>&skills=<names>, the endpoint the CLI calls at add time when telemetry is on.

trial.prune_rule: A skill installed for at least window_days with zero invocations in the last window_days is demoted one step (on -> name-only -> off) or removed; kept verdict winners change only through a verdict re-record.
trial.confound: name-only and user-invocable-only listings depress proactive invocation; compare only within a listing state.

measurement.claude: native /skill-doctor (claude -p "/skill-doctor"), run by hand per host
measurement.codex: tools/skill-usage/skill_usage.py over explicitly passed rollout roots

trial.verdict_boundary: Trial skills are not verdict winners; catalogs/landscape/foundation.json instructions-skills is unchanged until a sealed re-record.

settings_propagation: adoption/templates/claude.settings.template.json skillOverrides, applied by tools/adoption/apply_claude_settings.py (deep merge; a key removed here is never removed from a host, so demotion writes an explicit state).
